baseline_models.focus_anchor: The frame إن الله ... إن الله, عنده علم الساعة, three ع ل م forms, and the two ما تدري نفس clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge is presented as present with God, disclosed to its knower, and deepened into expertise in inward matters; each living self is denied comparable access to its own next acquisition and terminal ground.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence make divine knowledge the located center of the asymmetry.
Disclosure to a knower spans noun, verb, and final adjective and binds the enumerated domains.
Ordinary knowing is negated twice for every self and supplies the human side of the contrast.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality closes the mechanism as depth rather than mere forecasting.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of separate facts known only by God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an epistemic asymmetry: future events are present to divine disclosure and inward expertise while each self lacks access to its own next gain and ending place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ينزل الغيث, ما في الأرحام, تكسب غدا, and بأي أرض تموت.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delivery from above becomes rain, relief, and plant growth; the sequence then passes through concealed gestation, self-acquisition, fertile ground, and ground without life. The items form a provision-to-life-to-termination circuit rather than a flat catalog.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and conveyance make rain the initiating transfer in the circuit.
Growth produced by rain supplies the first visible life-output of the transfer.
Relief of distress makes provision functional rather than merely meteorological.
The female womb provides the concealed chamber of generation.
Seeking and obtaining provision turns the grown self into the circuit's active recipient.
Fertile ground links rain and growth to the still-unknown ground of death.
Lifeless land materially folds termination back into the earth that had supported growth.

changed_reading.before: Rain, wombs, earnings, and death are independent unknowns.
changed_reading.after: They form a causal life circuit: provision descends, growth is concealed and sustained, a self acquires, and life terminates on an unknown ground.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from visible rain to concealed wombs and futures, closed by عليم خبير.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mark-bearing branch of knowledge and the inward-expertise branch of خبر divide the ayah into signs that can be seen and interiors or outcomes that cannot be directly inspected by the self.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark turns observable effects into guides without making their hidden outcomes transparent.
Rain descending from the sky supplies the manifest event from which effects can be read.
The womb supplies a bounded but concealed interior.
Expertise in inward reality names the depth that signs alone do not disclose.

changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts readable manifestations with inaccessible interiors: signs guide a creature, but divine expertise reaches contents, consequences, and endings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ما تدري, غدا as forward time, and بأي أرض as an unknown destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant split-root branch under د ر ي contributes road-bearing and wind-alignment. Joined to morning departure, foreign ground, and death, ignorance becomes lack of orientation along a lived trajectory, not only absence of a datum.

activation_trace.role: Road bearing, wind direction, and alignment supply a branch-distant navigation image for the negated knowing.
Setting out at the start of day turns tomorrow into forward movement.
The stranger of a land makes the self unplaced relative to its eventual destination.
Loss of life fixes the trajectory's terminal event while leaving its ground unknown.

changed_reading.before: A person lacks two future facts.
changed_reading.after: A person travels without a reliable bearing toward tomorrow's work and an unknown final land; the reading is spatial and processual as well as epistemic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation scene joins support, seeing, descending water, and growth. It strengthens the baseline sign/interior model by making hidden support and visible effect a recurring structure that can extend to wombs and futures.

activation_trace.role: The focus knowledge-mark branch anchors the changed reading in signs that guide without exhausting hidden causes.
The focus womb remains the concealed generative interior to which the pattern is applied.
A supporting pillar supplies the causal support whose visibility is grammatically denied in the scene.
Eyesight marks the limit between what appears and what still supports the appearing order.
Human growth extends rain-grown emergence from vegetation toward embodied generation.

structural_cues: 31:10 moves from supports not seen to stabilized earth, descending water, and growth in pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen support, visual perception, and rain-grown pairs; I infer a hidden-cause to visible-effect pattern and apply it to the womb/future sequence; alternatively these may remain separate creation signs.

changed_reading.before: The womb is merely one inaccessible container in a list.
changed_reading.after: Womb contents and future outcomes belong to a repeated hidden-support and visible-growth pattern: effects can become signs while their exact causes and termini remain with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maternal sequence turns the womb from a static box of hidden contents into a timed process of concealed carrying, accumulating weakness, separation, years, and eventual destination.

activation_trace.role: The female womb anchors the revision in the focus ayah's concealed generative site.
An inward load or fruit supplies gestation as an ongoing hidden carrying.
Repeated weakening gives the process a cumulative bodily cost.
Separation of child from mother or nursing supplies a bounded transition out of gestation.
The year as a temporal cycle measures formation and separation rather than merely naming a date.
Becoming toward an outcome extends embodied formation into a larger trajectory of return.

structural_cues: 31:14 orders carrying, weakness upon weakness, weaning in two years, gratitude, and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gestational and post-gestational sequence; I infer that ما في الأرحام can denote an unfolding history as well as a hidden identity; the static fetal-fact reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge identifies what is currently inside wombs.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge encompasses a womb's whole timed becoming: hidden burden, bodily cost, separation, maturation, and destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mustard-grain scene gives a hidden thing exact weight and location, then has God bring it forth. Knowledge in the focus ayah therefore becomes operative retrieval and arrival of concealed consequence, not passive inventory alone.

activation_trace.role: The focus acquisition anchors the retrieved hidden item as a consequence of what a self does or gains.
Exact weight turns an unspecified outcome into a measured object at minute scale.
A seed that can grow makes the minute hidden item latent with consequence.
Coming and bringing supply the transition from concealed existence to arrived outcome.
Minuteness and concealment explain why ordinary inspection fails without implying absence.
Expertise in inward reality binds the retrieval scene directly to the focus closing title.

structural_cues: 31:16 places the tiny item in rock, heavens, or earth before the verb of divine bringing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exact scale, broad location, bringing, and inward expertise; I infer knowledge-to-arrival as the causal arrow; alternatively the scene may concern moral accountability without revising the focus's epistemic sense.

changed_reading.before: God already knows hidden future facts.
changed_reading.after: God's knowledge tracks and can bring forth even the smallest concealed consequence, so tomorrow's acquisition and final ground are outcomes that arrive, not inert entries in a forecast.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible and inward blessing are paired, while deeds are placed beside knowledge of the chest as their source. The focus contrast between signs and interiors becomes a flow from inward state to outward work and later disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Inward expertise anchors the context's surface-to-depth movement in the focus closing title.
Emergence and visibility supply the manifest side of the paired blessings.
The hidden interior of an affair supplies the paired depth that is not exhausted by appearance.
Intentional action supplies the outward event later reported back to its doer.
The chest as origin of actions gives the mechanism a directional source beneath the deed.

structural_cues: 31:20 pairs manifest and inward blessings; 31:23 pairs return and report of deeds with knowledge of the essence of chests.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a surface/interior pair and an action/chest juxtaposition; I infer that inward orientation externalizes as deed and is later disclosed; alternatively the pairings may make two independent claims.

changed_reading.before: Divine expertise reaches static hidden contents.
changed_reading.after: Divine expertise follows a dynamic path from inward source through outward deed to disclosed consequence, including what a self will acquire tomorrow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pens, replenishing sea-ink, and unexhausted words recast divine knowledge as an expressive abundance no finite material record can contain. Human non-knowledge is thus a scale mismatch as well as a temporal limit.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the expressive abundance in the focus's repeated knowledge forms.
The prepared writing reed supplies the finite recording instrument.
Vast abundant water supplies a material scale already beyond an ordinary record.
An inkwell feeding a pen converts the sea's extension into continued expression.
Exhaustion and ending are negated for the divine words and define the failed limit.
An intelligible expression turns divine abundance into communicable articulation rather than mute quantity.

structural_cues: 31:27 is a material counterfactual: all earthly trees become pens and successive seas still fail to exhaust the words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite writing materials and unexhausted divine expression; I infer that the focus knowledge is generative and articulable abundance; alternatively the scene may function only as a magnitude comparison.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is a larger store of the same kind of facts humans seek.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge exceeds the capacity of finite recording and continually supports expression, while a self cannot even close its own next-day forecast.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation and reawakening of the many are compared to one self. This makes the focus's repeated indefinite self simultaneously an irreducible personal horizon and no obstacle to divine comprehension of all selves at once.

activation_trace.role: The self as the thing's own identity anchors both unknown clauses in an individual bearer.
Stirring what is still supplies reactivation across the boundary of death.
One self provides the context's unit for compressing the many without erasing identity.
Union in one direction supplies the many-as-one scaling operation.

structural_cues: 31:28 negates any difference in difficulty between creating or raising all and doing so for one self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies many addressed persons, one-self comparison, and reawakening; I infer simultaneous individuation and divine scalability; alternatively the comparison may state ease alone.

changed_reading.before: Each occurrence of نفس only generalizes human ignorance.
changed_reading.after: Each self owns a bounded future horizon, yet all such distinct horizons are comprehended and reactivated as readily as one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night enters day and day enters night while celestial bodies run toward an appointed term. This activates the branch-distant drift in الساعة and changes the hour from a detached timestamp into knowledge of interpenetrating phases, trajectories, and their limits.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going on its course contributes branch-distant drift to the focus hour without replacing its ordinary temporal sense.
Entry of one thing into another supplies reciprocal phase transition.
Night and its darkness supply one moving phase of the cycle.
Day opening in light supplies the counterphase that expands as night enters it.
Flowing motion turns cosmic time into trajectory rather than a static clock face.
A prescribed temporal limit gives each trajectory a known terminus.
Inward expertise connects the cosmic timing mechanism to what people are doing within it.

structural_cues: 31:29 repeats reciprocal insertion, then gives sun and moon a shared running construction toward a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies phase-entry, flow, and fixed termini; I infer that knowledge of the hour includes the convergence of running processes; the ordinary reading of one final eschatological moment remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of the Hour means possession of one hidden date.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge of the Hour can also mean complete grasp of nested temporal phases, moving agents, and the precise termini toward which they run.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship runs through wide water, an intermingled wave covers the travelers, and rescue reaches dry or raised land. The unknown earth of death becomes a contingent landfall reached through forces the self cannot chart.

activation_trace.role: Road bearing and wind alignment anchor the navigation reading in the focus's repeated negated knowing.
Ground opposite the sky anchors the eventual destination in the focus phrase.
A vessel moving circularly on water supplies the travel platform.
Flowing and coursing supply forward motion through an unstable medium.
Wide abundant water supplies the open field in which destination is not fixed by the traveler.
Intermingled turbulence supplies the contingency that interrupts deliberate navigation.
Raised saving ground turns rescue into arrival at a viable landfall.
Dry land supplies the shore reached after danger at sea.

structural_cues: 31:31-32 moves from ship travel to engulfing wave to rescue onto land immediately before the final warning and focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel, current, wave, rescue, and dry land; I infer landfall as a model for the focus's unknown death-ground; alternatively أرض remains only a geographic coordinate.

changed_reading.before: No self knows the geographic place where it will die.
changed_reading.after: No self can chart the contingent currents by which it will reach its final ground; place is an arrived landfall as well as a coordinate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier gratitude benefits the self that performs it, and the final warning denies substitution even between parent and child. The focus self's acquisition and death are therefore personally accruing and nontransferable, not merely unknown.

activation_trace.role: The self as its own identity anchors both future clauses in a particular bearer.
Self-directed acquisition supplies what personally accrues before the terminal event.
Recognition of benefit makes the action reflexively beneficial to its doer in the verse's construction.
The context self identifies the recipient of the action's benefit with the acting person.
One thing standing in place of another is explicitly denied across the parent-child relation.
Offspring and parent supply the closest kinship test for failed substitution.

structural_cues: 31:12 says the grateful act is for the actor's own self; 31:33 repeats both directions of failed parent-child substitution; 31:34 repeats no self twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive benefit and failed kin substitution; I infer that tomorrow's gain and death remain attached to the same self; alternatively nontransferability may apply only to the feared day in 31:33.

changed_reading.before: Every person independently lacks future information.
changed_reading.after: Every self bears an unborrowable trajectory: its acts and gains accrue to it, and even its closest kin cannot occupy its place at the terminal reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a sexual-fluid branch beneath rain's descent; it remains anchored by the focus adjacency of rain and womb and by 31:10's water and human-growth branches; downstream prose should call it a generative material analogy, not a replacement lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ينزل الغيث immediately precedes يعلم ما في الأرحام.

activation_trace.role: Emission of male fluid gives descent a branch-distant reproductive transfer.
The female womb provides the receiving and growing interior.
Male fluid in the womb explicitly bridges the context water lexeme to generation.
Human growth lets the water-to-plant sequence serve as an embodied growth analogy.

changed_reading.before: Rain descent and womb knowledge are adjacent but independent domains.
changed_reading.after: Rain-to-earth and generative-fluid-to-womb become parallel transfers whose hidden reception produces growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch of غد reaches unborn contents and their sale under uncertainty; it remains anchored by the focus's womb, tomorrow, and acquisition sequence and by 31:33's outcome-risk warning; downstream prose should present it as an anti-speculative resonance, not derive a legal ruling or replace tomorrow's ordinary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما في الأرحام is followed by ماذا تكسب غدا.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the hidden contents whose outcome cannot yet be inspected.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies the transactional side of tomorrow's uncertainty.
The pregnant-contents branch carries an uncertainty-of-sale edge into the word for tomorrow.
Risk and ignorance of the outcome activate the latent uncertainty joining womb contents to future gain.

changed_reading.before: Womb contents and tomorrow's earnings are two unrelated unknowns.
changed_reading.after: Their adjacency warns against treating concealed development or future gain as a secured asset when its outcome is structurally unknown.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes knowledge as stored and circulating water; it remains anchored in focus branches for gathered water, rain, and water-holding ground and in 31:27's sea-fed writing image; downstream prose should retain it only as a hydraulic analogy for abundance and transmission.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عنده علم, ينزل الغيث, and the closing خبير occur within one frame.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water gives the repeated knowledge root a reservoir image.
Life-giving rain supplies an outflow from above into the lived world.
Soft low ground that gathers water supplies reception and retention at the frame's close.
The vast sea expands the reservoir image beyond finite measure.
An inkwell feeding a pen converts stored fluid into continued inscription.
Intelligible expression makes the hydraulic outflow communicative rather than merely physical.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract possession and rain is a separate act.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge can be imagined as an inexhaustible reservoir whose outflows become provision, signs, and expression while finite receivers hold only local portions.

strongest_changes: The womb became a timed process of carrying, weakening, separation, and destination rather than a static hidden container.
The mustard-grain scene changed divine knowledge from passive inventory into exact retrieval and arrival of concealed consequence.
The self's future became nontransferable through reflexive benefit and the failed parent-child substitution in 31:33.
Night-day flow, appointed terms, sea travel, and land rescue changed future ignorance into a problem of phase, trajectory, and contingent landfall.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root branches and tight material sequences preserved several coexisting readings: epistemic asymmetry, ecological generation, interior-to-deed disclosure, navigation, outcome risk, and hydraulic abundance.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant د ر ر navigation branch is visibly productive but should remain exploratory.
The غدوي and غرر resonance may be a lexical accident rather than an intended anti-speculative layer.
The generative-fluid and hydraulic models are branch-distant analogies and should not displace the ordinary rain, tomorrow, and knowledge senses.
